items.headline: Lost 3 bike lights this year? Same.
items.body: Amsterdam charges a theft tax and it is called 'buying new lights again'. Nachtfiets: EUR 9/month, stolen lights replaced within 24h, free. Waitlist opens for October.
items.rationale: Hook post that names the shared pain in the first line.

items.headline: A EUR 60 fine for a EUR 4 light
items.body: Every autumn, thousands of Amsterdam commuters get fined for riding without lights, usually because the lights were stolen the week before. We built Nachtfiets to end that loop: a pair of bright clip lights on subscription, replaced free within 24 hours whenever they disappear. EUR 9 a month. We launch in October and are opening a waitlist today.
items.rationale: Offer post with commuter credibility for the LinkedIn audience.
risk_flags: unverified claim: 'thousands of commuters get fined'

message_to_team: Board, three posts are in your inbox: an X hook, an Instagram story and a LinkedIn offer. I flagged one unverified number on the LinkedIn post. Kofi, posters please.
